response.sql: WITH event_totals AS (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(spent) as total_spent, SUM(amount) as total_amount FROM budget WHERE spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), event_ratios AS (SELECT link_to_event, CASE WHEN total_amount > 0 THEN total_spent * 1.0 / total_amount ELSE NULL END as spend_ratio FROM event_totals), avg_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) as avg_spend_ratio FROM event_ratios) SELECT link_to_event as event_id, spend_ratio, CASE WHEN spend_ratio IS NOT NULL THEN spend_ratio / avg_spend_ratio ELSE NULL END as relative_ratio FROM event_ratios CROSS JOIN avg_ratio ORDER BY CASE WHEN relative_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
